scientific.scope: 真实 B-DQ/R-DQ 钢种计算；不开展第六阶段求解器调试，不更换或升级 pycalphad，不排除 875/900 degC，不继续缩减组元或相集合。
reasons: 全组元体系 16 个组元条目超过本机 pycalphad 0.11.2 实测求解容量上界 13。
缩减体系在 B-DQ 875/900 degC 附近不稳定收敛：全新进程重复求解同一单点条件，900 degC 成功 1/8、875 degC 成功 2/4，失败形态为没有任何相摩尔数。
批量模式与独立点模式在 R-DQ 675 degC 的共同收敛点上相差 1.069e-4（容差 1e-7）：相同三相组合、相分数不同。

component.name: pycalphad
component.license_holder_line: Copyright (c) 2014-2023 Richard Otis and Zi-Kui Liu
component.compiled_dependency_risk: symengine<0.14,>=0.9.2 is a compiled dependency; a matching wheel for the isolated interpreter must be confirmed before any install.
component.citation: Otis, R. & Liu, Z.-K. (2017). pycalphad: CALPHAD-based Computational Thermodynamics in Python. Journal of Open Research Software, 5(1), p.1. DOI 10.5334/jors.140

source_check.method: Read the official PyPI JSON metadata (project metadata, requires_python, classifiers, requires_dist, per-file sha256) and the LICENSE.txt served from the pinned Git tag; resolved the tag commit through the GitHub REST API; then installed the pinned wheel into an isolated environment and recorded the resolved package set and wheel hashes in requirements-calphad-win-py312.lock.
source_check.untrusted_input_note: Every value above was reproduced from official upstream sources, not from third-party summaries.
verified_in_phase_2: The pinned pycalphad 0.11.2 wheel was installed into .venv-pycalphad and its sha256 matches the value registered in phase 1.
All 34 resolved packages are locked with sha256 in requirements-calphad-win-py312.lock.
pycalphad 0.11.2 imports and exposes Database and Workspace under CPython 3.12.14.
not_yet_verified: The transitive dependency versions were resolved on this machine only; a clean-room reinstall from the lock file has not been attempted.
The isolated interpreter is not self-contained (see installed_environment.interpreter_base_note).
verified_in_phase_3: The registered community derivative parses with pycalphad 0.11.2 under an explicit utf-8 decode (Database.from_string / Database.from_file); Database(path) also parses when the interpreter runs with -X utf8.
The independent diff audit against the TU Wien original reports passed_syntax_repairs_only with 0 unexplained deviations over the shared statement set.

The community repository's five binary systems / fifteen stated checks were re-implemented from the criteria and all fifteen reproduced on our own runs (raw report in the git-ignored outputs/ directory).
Nine project-relevant binary/ternary systems covering Fe-C (stable and metastable), Fe-Cr-C, Fe-Mn, Fe-Si, Fe-Nb, Fe-V, Fe-B and Fe-N passed 18 of 18 plausibility checks.

A component-count sweep on the candidate and on the independent COST507 control database reproduced the same solver capacity limit (13 solvable / 14 failing), which is therefore an environment limitation and not a database defect.
verified_in_phase_4: The fixed 12-component steel_matrix_equilibrium_v1 profile and the fixed 7-phase steel_matrix_major_carbides_v1 range were approved, registered and made non-selectable (no generic element or phase switch).
Every phase in the profile exists, carries parameters, builds a solvable phase record and is stable somewhere in the declared component system; none had to be removed.
Without a named reviewer the run blocks with CALPHAD-COMP-011 and produces no request.
R-DQ solves across all 54 temperature points with phase-fraction sums of 0.9999999998-1.0000000004, a physically correct assemblage sequence, and run-to-run agreement within 3e-9.
B-DQ does not converge at 875 degC in the batch scan, so T86 stays Blocked.

A defect was found and fixed: omitting VA from the pycalphad component list returned LIQUID-stable-at-400 degC while the phase-fraction sum stayed 1. A physical plausibility guard was added because a sum-only check cannot catch this.
verified_in_phase_5: The formal solver mode is independent_single_point_process_v1: one fresh worker process per temperature point, one temperature per process, strictly serial, no warm start, identical inputs except temperature.
The batch warm-start path is retained as diagnostic_only and never returns a formal pilot result.

Every point carries the full contract (request hash, worker PID, exit code, VA presence, phase sums, runtime, sanitized stderr, first-attempt flag, solver mode) and the run carries a manifest integrity hash.
The parent merges only first-attempt-success points that pass contract validation; a missing point yields no partial curve.
A single diagnostic retry is recorded but never spliced into the formal curve and never turns a failed formal point into a pass.

Independent-mode acceptance showed that the failure is NOT caused by warm-starting: the same single-point conditions still fail non-deterministically in fresh processes (875 degC and 900 degC for B-DQ), so T86 stays Blocked.

database.selected_database: Third-party community derivative of MatCalc mc_fe v2.062 (file 2databases/mc_fe_v2062_clean.tdb, repo adityamoolya/maraging-steel-calphad-dft, commit 19b11640253543fe412145498438cb8355a32561); upstream ODbL 1.0 + DbCL 1.0 preserved in the file header
database.selected_database_naming_rule: This candidate must never be described as a TU Wien official pycalphad-compatible build, a pycalphad official database, or a validated SteelAI database. It is a third-party community derivative candidate.

upstream_original.reason: pycalphad 0.11.2 cannot parse the raw vendor file (REFERENCE_ELEMENT at line 180, column 18).

database.pycalphad_compatibility_gate_scope: File parsing, TDB grammar and model-structure inspection of the registered candidate with pycalphad 0.11.2 under CPython 3.12.14. It does NOT mean the candidate can solve the project sample compositions; see solver_capability_limit.
database.independent_validation_summary: community binary claims 15/15 reproduced, project-relevant checks 18/18 passed, MC/MX reachability probe agreed with the documented expectation; raw report in the git-ignored outputs/ directory
database.user_must_supply: 已由项目负责人指定社区派生候选；若更换数据库，仍需重新登记来源、版本/日期、许可或授权依据、适用钢种、覆盖元素、温度适用区间与 SHA-256。

batch_workspace_warm_start.note: 第四阶段的多温度批量路径；仅保留为诊断与模式对照证据。

reduced_system.acceptance_detail: 324 个独立点中 320 个首次调用即成功（成功率 0.9877）；4 个失败点全部是 B-DQ 的 875 degC 与 900 degC，且诊断重试也失败。同一条件在全新进程中重复调用会随机返回没有任何相摩尔数（B-DQ 900 degC 成功 1/8、875 degC 成功 2/4），说明是该体系在此温区的求解不确定性问题，与求解模式无关。另有第二个阻断项：R-DQ 批量模式与独立点模式在 675 degC 的共同收敛点上相差 1.069e-4（容差 1e-7），两种模式找到相同三相组合但相分数不同，按规则不得自行取舍。详见 docs/T86_PHASE5_INDEPENDENT_POINTS.md 与 config/calphad_phase5_evidence_v1.0.json。

component_profile.component_list_length_note: 13 = 12 approved elements + VA (vacancy). VA is mandatory for the substitutional phases of this database; omitting it makes pycalphad return a physically wrong assemblage whose phase fractions still sum to 1. See docs/T86_PHASE4_REDUCED_SYSTEM.md section 7.

not_computed_in_this_phase: 析出动力学、偏聚、晶界脆化与实际组织含量

reduced_system.phase5_note: 第四阶段的批量路径（batch_workspace_warm_start）自第五阶段起仅用于诊断；正式路径为 independent_single_point_process_v1。
reduced_system.blocking_reason: B-DQ does not converge at 875 degC in the multi-temperature batch scan, even after the bounded single-temperature retry. R-DQ passes with identical components and phases.
reduced_system.known_defect_fixed: The component list must contain VA. pycalphad silently returns a wrong assemblage (LIQUID stable at 400 degC) when VA is omitted, and the phase-fraction sum still equals 1, so a sum-only check cannot detect it.

solver_capability_limit.summary: pycalphad 0.11.2 on this host cannot solve an equilibrium whose component list is longer than 13 entries (Fe + 11 alloying elements + VA). At 14 entries it either exhausts memory or aborts the process inside pycalphad/core/minimizer.
solver_capability_limit.control_database_component_limit: identical (13 solvable / 14 failing), so this is not caused by the community derivative
observed_failure_modes: MemoryError: Unable to allocate 10.9 GiB for an array with shape (1, 1, 54, 933583, 29) and data type float64 (product path, worker exit code 2)
0xC0000374 HEAP_CORRUPTION inside the same native extension
unbounded memory growth with no result (validation harness, terminated by timeout)
solver_capability_limit.project_sample_impact: B-DQ and R-DQ both have 16 component entries, so the phase-fraction curve cannot be produced in this environment.
solver_capability_limit.not_permitted_to_work_around_silently: Reducing the component system, restricting the phase list or replacing the isolated environment all change the scientific claim; each requires a named owner decision and a versioned update of the controlled element exclusion policy. The adapter and worker never downgrade the calculation on their own.

controlled_element_exclusion.scope: 只有政策中逐条列出的 (sample_id, element, category) 才可排除；其他任何未覆盖的非零元素仍以 CALPHAD-COMP-002 阻断。

method.output_phase_fraction_basis_note: 输出为各相摩尔分数（相内摩尔数占比），不是质量分数；质量分数换算未在第一阶段实现。
method.equilibrium_conditions: 固定成分、固定压力 101325 Pa、温度单变量扫描
method.missing_value_rule: 未提供（空白/NA）的元素不得按 0 参与计算；要么补值，要么由具名用户显式声明其按未检出处理并从体系中排除。
method.uncovered_element_rule: 成分中任何非零元素若不在 TDB 覆盖元素内，一律阻断计算，没有覆盖开关，不静默省略、不补零。
